title: Blelp
headline: Blelp
tagline: Ratings and Reviews platform for hair and beauty service provider.
about: acts as a safe space for black women to ensure they’re getting the best quality products and services for their money. For beauty providers to truly thrive in the competitive landscape Blelp encourage a healthy and constructive feedback culture between the black consumer and black business owners. The ultimate goal of Blelp is to hold Instagram hair and beauty providers accountable and facilitate black people in trusting black businesses economically by providing ratings and reviews platform.
